old_caption: The video opens with an aerial view of a cityscape enveloped in dense fog. The scene is dominated by a thick layer of mist that obscures much of the urban environment below. In the background, several tall buildings stand out against the hazy backdrop, their silhouettes barely visible through the fog. The foreground features a mix of greenery and lower-rise structures, which are also partially hidden by the fog. The fog appears to be moving slightly, creating a dynamic and ever-changing atmosphere. The overall mood is one of mystery and tranquility, as the viewer is drawn into the serene yet enigmatic world created by the fog.
original_wisa_caption: The video opens with an aerial view of a cityscape enveloped in dense fog. The scene is dominated by a thick layer of mist that obscures much of the urban environment below. In the background, several tall buildings stand out against the hazy backdrop, their silhouettes barely visible through the fog. The foreground features a mix of greenery and lower-rise structures, which are also partially hidden by the fog. As the video progresses, the camera slowly pans across the scene, revealing more details of the city's layout and the interplay between the built environment and the natural elements. The fog appears to be moving slightly, creating a dynamic and ever-changing atmosphere. The overall mood is one of mystery and tranquility, as the viewer is drawn into the serene yet enigmatic world created by the fog.
caption: A high-angle aerial view shows a city lit by warm orange sun on the right and cool teal shadow on the left. A fixed skyline lines the left edge: a cylindrical-topped tower, a striped slab building, and distant blocks fading behind haze. The center and right are dominated by a thick billowing cloud that partly swallows low rooftops, including a flat-roofed building in the lower-center. Within the frame, the illuminated cloud mass continuously billows and reshapes, its orange highlights and internal swirls shifting position from moment to moment. A darker greenish plume in the left-center rises and thins, changing its silhouette against the buildings and brighter cloud. The cloud boundary over the lower-center rooftop advances and retreats, alternately obscuring and revealing the flat roof and its small structure. The overall cloud drifts slowly rightward and becomes slightly more diffuse, while the left skyline holds its position throughout.

Write a corrected WISA-style training caption for this exact video clip.
This clip is a temporally cropped excerpt, with arbitrary start and end boundaries. It is NOT
necessarily a complete action and it is NOT a loop. Describe the visible portion of a process
without inventing how it began or how it ultimately ends. A process may already be happening
on the first frame and still be happening after the last. Do not force the endpoints to match,
infer a physical error from their mismatch, or manufacture continuity across a visible edit.
Use the chronological video as primary evidence. The independent visual notes are fallible aids,
not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.
Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.
Aim for 85-115% of the original WISA word count,
and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
